Subject: Fwd: Private offer: term flex & rev-share request from Novarise

Team — fwd'ing Lisa's asks. Quick summary and ask below.

Summary: Novarise requests 25% one-time discount months 1–6, Net-90 payment, and will accept a 3% rev-share uplift to their reseller as the trade. They are committing to a 12-month ARR target but want Net-90 ASAP.

My ask: Can Deal Desk approve an accelerated discount + Net-90 for this strategic retail pilot? If not, what alternative concessions should we offer (e.g., 15% onboarding credit + invoice acceleration to Net-45, or milestone prepayment to cover cash exposure)?

Numbers: baseline hosted invoice estimate = $240k over 12 months. 25% 6-month credit reduces near-term revenue by ~ $30k, and Net-90 introduces ~60–75 days DSO exposure. Rev-share increase to reseller is estimated to reduce Marketplace take by ~3% of qualifying transacted dollars.

I have a draft private offer (PrivOffer_Draft_v3.docx) that I can update pending guidance.

Cheers,
Mateo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer: term flex & rev-share request from Novarise

Mateo —

Thanks for the summary. This is a classic early-adopter ask: high strategic value but non-standard commercial terms and cash exposure. My initial read: 25% full discount for 6 months + Net-90 is too aggressive without prepayment or a risk buffer.

Suggested negotiation levers:
- Offer 15% onboarding credit applied across months 1–3 instead of 25% months 1–6.
- Offer Net-60 (not Net-90) with a milestone invoice schedule (25% upfront on signature, 50% at go-live, remainder on 30 days).
- If Novarise insists on Net-90, require a delayed rev-share payment deferral or a partial prepayment/letter of credit to cover DSO exposure.
- For the marketplace rev-share increase, cap the rev-share uplift to reseller at 3% but limit it to purchases routed through their reseller partner (not platform-wide).

If the customer absolutely needs Net-90 and full 25% 6-month credit, we should escalate for exec approval with numbers and proposed mitigation (advance invoice/credit reserve). Can you prepare a short one-pager (revenue impact, cash exposure, recommended mitigation) and loop Markus for approval?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2029 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: Novarise private offer (summary & numbers)

Markus —

Quick note and ask. We have a strategic retail pilot (Novarise) requesting the following non-standard terms: 25% off hosted invoice charges months 1–6 + Net-90 payment, with a 3% rev-share uplift to their reseller. Key points:
- 12-month minimum commitment, estimated billings $240k ARR.
- Near-term revenue credit impact (if we grant full 25% for 6 months): ~$30k gross reduction in the first 6 months.
- Cash exposure: Net-90 increases DSO by ~60 days; with 240k ARR this equates to roughly $40–60k working capital exposure across the year (est.).
- Marketplace impact: 3% reseller uplift reduces platform take on partner-routed transactions; we can limit scope to reseller-tagged purchases.

Recommended compromise (Deal Desk preferred): 15% credit applied months 1–3 + Net-60 with 25% initial invoice on signature. If you approve full request, propose these safety conditions: 1) require a signed prepayment milestone (25%) on signature; 2) rev-share uplift capped at 3% and scoped to reseller-directed deals; 3) legal to sign standard redline that limits retroactive price changes.

Attached: short one-pager included inline below and PrivOffer_Draft_v3.docx.

One-pager (inline):
- Baseline 12-mo billed ARR: $240,000
- Immediate 6-month credit (25%): revenue delta -$30,000
- Suggested alternative: 15% x 3 months credit = -$9,000 and Net-60 reduces cash exposure by ~30 days vs Net-90
- Risk mitigation: 25% signature invoice / milestone triggers / scoped rev-share

Can you sign off or advise? Customer is requesting turnaround by Friday to keep implementation timeline.

Thanks,
Mateo
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jul 2029 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Novarise private offer (summary & numbers)

Team —

I appreciate the clear summary. Decision: approve a constrained version of the customer's request with the following conditions:

1) Credit: Approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% applied across months 1–4 (compromise between 25% x6 and 15% x3).
2) Payment terms: Approve Net-60 only. If Novarise requires Net-90, approval is conditional on receipt of 25% prepayment at signature plus a short-term credit reserve held for first two invoice cycles.
3) Rev-share: Allow a 3% reseller uplift but strictly scoped to transactions marked by reseller partner ID. This is not platform-wide. Legal to place a 12-month carveout clause in the private offer.
4) Contracting: Legal must redline the private offer to include standard audit rights and a clause that disallows retroactive price changes.

Margin/cash note: These concessions are acceptable for a strategic pilot if finance signs the prepayment/reserve mechanism. Karthik, please prepare the updated private offer reflecting the above and route to Legal and Finance for sign-off. Mateo—please communicate these conditions back to Novarise and ask for an acknowledgement by Friday.

Markus Klein
SVP, Commercial & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
